## Observed documentation mismatch The official [`@unbrained/pm-case@2026.11.6` npm release](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@unbrained/pm-case/v/2026.11.6) is live, but its checksum-verified tarball README and the [default-branch README](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-case#install) still describe the candidate as local and unpublished. The archive-building route comes first; ordinary npm/Bun installation is described as a future step. On Node 24.22.1 I installed the verified published PM Case and PM CLI 2026.11.16 tarballs in a fresh npm consumer, activated the installed extension in a disposable non-Git tracker, and successfully created a model and proposed/selected the four cases in a 2×2 fixture. The package works through the scoped coordinate and the `pm case` extension identity; no runtime or npm availability defect is implied. The stale opening can nevertheless send users or agents through a source checkout and pack workflow they do not need. ## Acceptance - Lead with a fresh npm/Bun consumer and scoped registry installation today; preserve the separate tracker activation step, the `npm:` prefix for registry activation through PM, and the fact that there is no standalone binary. - Keep source checkout, archive review and prepublication instructions only as an explicitly optional maintainer path. - Check the rendered GitHub and the next actually published npm README; a successful git merge alone does not update the current registry artifact. - Preserve the no-Git pack/activation and command smoke coverage. Related shipped publication work: [PR #14](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-case/pull/14) and its [scoped registry tracking item](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-case/blob/main/.agents/pm/chores/pm-case-scoped-npm-name.toon). This is a post-publication documentation follow-up, not a request to republish or rename. --- ### GitHub comments (2) > **@coderabbitai[bot]** (2026-11-16T10:37:43Z) > > > > >

Drop into our [discord](https://discord.gg/coderabbit)! > **@unbraind** (2026-11-19T06:21:51Z) > > New evidence for the archive fallback in this issue: [release preparation run 44462023939](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-case/actions/runs/44462023939/job/135350999392) failed the documented archive-install test in `test/review-classes.test.ts`. > > At [`b0ea60a`](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-case/commit/b0ea60a62cd9b63f5a3b3cdad5f38b4a0de37de1), the README names `unbrained-pm-case-2026.11.6.tgz`, while the test constructs the filename from the candidate version. In a clean temporary directory, the same README shell prefix with `npm` stubbed to check file existence passed with the `.11.6` archive and failed with only the `.11.19` archive. This isolates the path mismatch, not npm itself. > > Keep the fresh consumer smoke check and verify it also passes after a version bump, with the optional archive instructions using the actual packed filename.
Make the published PM Case README lead with registry installation
